boundary: Eight questions frozen before the next corrective implementation and before any generation for them. Agent-authored source-inspected questions, not independent human adjudication. No answers are sent to production.

cases.question: For CLD test day 17356, give the original fuel-bottle label, fuel-concentration range, both MFC entries and ignition count. Explain what the MFC values describe; retain unusual source spellings.
For s-Flame test day 19308, distinguish the atmosphere entry from the fuel-bottle entry and give the ignition count. Keep the gas labels exactly as recorded.
For BASS As Run Test number 4, identify the other recorded test and sample numbers, the fuel-sample material description, and GMT day. Keep the different identifiers separate.
For CFI-G test 21088 D1, report burn time, hot-ignition status, the termination entry and its recorded comment, and Tad. Distinguish the adiabatic parameter from a measured flame temperature.

In the PSI-115 final report and its data-organization document, what particle formation is modeled, which gravity cases are distinguished, and how is the no-thermophoresis variant defined? Explain the evidential status of these outputs.

Connect the shared SPICE/SLICE apparatus description with PSI-60 image processing: which optical instruments are reported, how are the Nikon image channels used, and what quantities does the processing seek to recover? Keep the apparatus report and the processing study distinct.

Compare the reported BRE low-momentum burning behavior with the qualified s-Flame extinction findings in the ACME ISS overview. Include the relevant oxygen/size or flow/diluent qualifications and keep the investigations separate.

For Electrical Wire Insulation Flammability Test 4 in NASA-STD-6001B with Change 3, explain the specimen count, dimensions, mounting and ignition, the observations to record, and the self-extinguishing criteria. Describe these as standard requirements.
